workflow: Leonardo da Vinci was an accomplished painter, inventor, and scientist. He was renowned for his work, including the Mona Lisa and The Last Supper, as well as his notable inventions—such as the helicopter and tank—and expertise in various fields including sculpture, anatomy, and draftsmanship.
